  '*Similitud t\u00e9cnica:* *' + 
  (($json.technique_similarity_percent !== undefined) 
      ? $json.technique_similarity_percent.toFixed(1) + '%' 
      : 'N/A') + '*\n\n' +
  'Feedback t\u00e9cnico:\n' +
  (($json.technique_feedback || [])
      .map(t => `\u2022 ${t}`)
      .join('\n') || '\u2022 (sin observaciones)')
}}
